title: Our Go-To Over-Ear Headphones Are at Their Lowest Price for Prime Day
author: Harry Rabinowitz

Learn more.Nothing's Headphone (1) is at its lowest price ever for Prime Day: $110 off the sticker price. It's one of our favorite over-ear headphones, especially if you appreciate a stylish design and physical, tactile buttons.I've tested over 100 earbuds and headphones, and have covered big sale events for years, including nearly a dozen Amazon Prime Days. Here's why you should give this deal a look.Also check out our other sale coverage: the Absolute Best Prime Day Deals, the Best Prime Day Tech Deals, and the Best Prime Day Headphone Deals.Nothing Headphone (1) for $189 ($110 Off)Photograph: Parker HallPhotograph: Parker HallPhotograph: Parker HallNothingHeadphone (1)$299 $189 (37% off) Amazon$299 $199 (33% off) Walmart$299 $219 (27% off) Best BuyThe Headphone (1) is Nothing's first over-ear headphones, launched back in 2025. They are noise-canceling headphones with a bold, transparent design that's somehow techy, retro, and futuristic all at once. The bold design was so successful that the brand followed up with the similar-looking but lower-priced Nothing Headphone (a) and the more premium Nothing Headphone (1) Pro.A big standout is the on-ear controls. They are all physical, clicky wheels, rockers, and buttons, a far cry from most over-ear headphones on the market. The wheel adjusts volume, plays and pauses music, and controls noise-canceling modes, while the stiff media rocker lets you go back and forth between tracks (and even fast-forward or rewind if you hold it down). It also has a physical on-off switch, Bluetooth pairing button, and voice assistant button.Noise cancellation, transparency, and sound quality are all excellent (though not as top-tier as pricier, $400-plus headphones from Sony, Bose, and Apple). And battery life, up to 35 hours with noise-canceling on, is more than many competitors. The headphones are so alluring that WIRED commerce director Cooper Fleishman recently bought a pair, and the discount he got wasn't even this good.Other Good Headphone Deals This Prime DayCourtesy of SonyCourtesy of SonySonyWH-1000XM5$400 $198 (51% off) Amazon$398 $198 (50% off) B&H Photo$400 $198 (51% off) SonyCourtesy of AmazonBoseQuietComfort Headphones (1st Gen)$359 $169 (53% off) Amazon$359 $249 (31% off) Best Buy$359 WalmartPower up with unlimited access to WIRED.
